title: C++: Concurrency (Simulated)
description: Simulate concurrency using function objects and parallel execution patterns (no std::thread).

steps.title: Task Parallelism
steps.description: Define a Task struct with a function and argument. Create a task list, execute tasks concurrently by interleaving their execution steps, and print results. Simulate 3 tasks that each count to 5 with delays.
hints: struct Task { void (*fn)(int); int arg; string name; };
Execute tasks in round-robin, one step at a time.
Print task name and current step.

verification.failureMessage: Run all 3 tasks with interleaved execution
